elder.name: Elder Sora
lines: Ah, a young ninja! I have been expecting you.
Our village needs a hero, and you carry the name Mega-Ninja.
Look around the village, then come back and see me. Your journey begins soon.
repeatLines: Walk with courage, young ninja.

farmer.name: Farmer
lines: Welcome to the farm! The soil here is perfect for wheat.
Take these seeds. Stand next to a dirt plot, face it, and press Space (or the A button) to plant.
Fill your watering can at the pump, then water what you plant. A blue drop means a plant is thirsty. Dark soil means it has been watered. A yellow sparkle means it is ready to pick.
Beware those pesky rabbits, digging holes! Throw them out of the garden, if you can catch them! Face one and press F to pick it up, then press F again to throw it.
farmer.ask: I could use {amount} {item}. Bring it to me and I will pay {reward} gold.
farmer.notEnough: You have {have} of the {amount} {item} I need. Come back when you have them.
farmer.thanks: That is just what I needed! Here is your {reward} gold.
farmer.nextAsk: Now I need {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
farmer.freeSeeds: Out of seeds? Take a few. I keep spares for this.
repeatLines: The fields are coming along. Come back soon.
farmer.ready: Is that {amount} {item} I see? Wonderful! Will you sell it to me for {reward} gold?

villager.name: Villager
lines: Oh no! The road south is buried under a landslide!
However will we dig all this up? It is a mountain of a problem... well, a hill. A very big hill.
Somebody will have to find a shovel.
repeatLines: Still no shovel? Rabbits dig holes all day. Maybe the ones on the farm know where to find one.

landslide_cleared: You did it! The road is open again. Thank you, hero!

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lines: Well, look at that. A ninja in my forest! Mind the branches.
Trees grow back, but they will not chop themselves. Take this axe. Face a tree and press Space to swing.
Axes wear out, mind. When it breaks, I can fix it for a bit of wood, or the market sells new ones.
lumberjack.ask: I can always use {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
lumberjack.thanks: Fine, honest timber! Here is your {reward} gold.
lumberjack.nextAsk: Next I need {amount} {item}. That is {reward} gold.
lumberjack.menu: What can I do for you?
lumberjack.broken: That axe of yours is done for. I can fix it for some wood, or you can buy a new one at the market.
lumberjack.spare: No axe, no wood, no coin? Take this old spare. It will not last, but it will get you some timber. Then bring me the wood.
repeatLines: Chop away.

shopkeeper.name: Shopkeeper
lines: Welcome to my stall! Seeds, tools, and a few things you cannot find anywhere else.
Bring gold and I will bring the goods.
repeatLines: Welcome back! What are you buying?

miner.name: Miner
lines: Welcome to the quarry! Every rock here hides something. Grey ones are plain stone, but you will find copper, and if you are lucky, gems.
Swing a pickaxe at a rock to break it. The harder the rock, the more swings it takes. Rocks grow back in a different colour.
See that big cave up north? Rumbling started in there a while back. Something is not right. I would not go in. Not yet.

sensei.name: Sensei
lines: Ah, a ninja who farms. Now that is rare. Every ninja should know the way of the blade, even one who grows wheat.
But I do not hand a sword to just anyone. A true blade begins as honest wood. Show me you can work.
sensei.ask: I could use {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.
sensei.notEnough: I need {amount} {item}. You have {have}. Keep at it.
sensei.thanks: Well done. Here is your {reward} gold.
sensei.nextAsk: When you are ready, bring me {amount} {item}. I will pay {reward} gold.

treant.name: Gnarl
lines: Thank you again, little ninja. The forest feels light again.
repeatLines: The sun is warm and my roots are quiet. Thank you.
Keep the lantern close. The deep cave is no place to be without a light.

cavesign.name: Sign
lines: DANGER! Unstable cave. Bring a light.
repeatLines: DANGER! Unstable cave. Bring a light.

treant_defeated: The cave mouth is just north of here. Watch out for bats!

wanderer.name: Wanderer
lines: Just stretching my legs. I never stay in one place for long.
If you ever see a rabbit near the farm, that is not my fault.
repeatLines: Nice day for a walk, isn't it?

sealeddoor.name: Stone Door
lines: A huge stone door, carved with a ninja crest.
Beneath it are four sockets: a ruby, a sapphire and an emerald, and a round crest in the middle.
repeatLines: The stone door is sealed tight. Four sockets wait below the crest.

sealeddooropen.name: Stone Door
lines: The door stands open. A cold wind blows up from the deep.
repeatLines: The passage leads down into the Crystal Caverns.

granite.name: Granite
lines: Granite is sorry for the rockfall. Granite is very glad the voice is gone.
repeatLines: Granite likes pickaxes now. They tickle.
Say hi to the bats for Granite. They are not so bad.

crystalnote.name: Torn Note
lines: A scout's note, half buried in glittering dust:
"Sensei - the princess came through here three nights ago, carrying the Moon Crest."
"The bats down here serve a Queen who sleeps in the roost to the south. Something whispers in her dreams. Do not wake her."
repeatLines: "...the princess went on alone. Find her. - a worried scout"

nooksign.name: Cold Draft
lines: A cold draft seeps through a crack in the crystal wall. You hear faint, strange music behind it.
repeatLines: The crack in the wall is too dim to see through. A brighter light might show the way.

hexsmith.name: Hexsmith
lines: Heh heh... a customer with a lantern. Not many find my little corner of the dark.
I forge weapons nobody else would dare to. Bring me gold and glow crystals, and I will make you something special.
hexsmith.offer: Today I could forge {name}: {desc}. It takes time. Come back after you have wandered off, and it will be waiting.
hexsmith.ordered: Deal! The forge is already glowing. Go on, wander off... and come back later.
hexsmith.working: Patience! The {name} is still cooling. Leave the market and come back, and it will be ready.
hexsmith.ready: Ah, there you are! Your {name} is ready. Handle it with care... it bites.
hexsmith.done: I have nothing finer left to forge for you. You carry my best work.
hexsmith.farewell: Heh heh. The dark will wait.
repeatLines: Back again? Let us see what I can forge for you.

hexcreature.name: Critter Seller
lines: Psst! Treats for little friends. Furry ones, flappy ones, glowy ones. All of them love a snack.
repeatLines: Treats for your little friends?

hexcharm.name: Charm Seller
lines: Shiny things! I pay well for gems and glow crystals. Better than the daytime market, hee hee.
repeatLines: Got any sparkle for me?

closedstall.name: Sign
lines: This stall is closed. A brewing pot bubbles inside. "Back soon. - The Brewer"
repeatLines: Closed. Something purple is bubbling inside.

hexcust1.name: Hooded Shopper
lines: I came for a lucky charm. The seller says all her charms are a little bit haunted.
repeatLines: Haunted charms are the best kind.

hexcust2.name: Cloaked Traveler
lines: Shh. Do not tell the daylight folk about this place. They would want a discount.
repeatLines: Our secret.

hexcust3.name: Little Witch
lines: My pet bat has no name yet. Do you have any ideas?
Everyone says friends are better when you pick the name yourself.
repeatLines: Maybe I will call her Biscuit.

hexcust4.name: Gloomy Shopper
lines: I heard a princess passed through here, asking about a Moon Crest.
She did not buy anything. She just looked sad and kept going.
repeatLines: Tell her I said hello, if you find her.

peaksign.name: Sign
lines: SNOWY PEAKS. Beware the Yeti in the den to the north. Frostberries grow on the bushes.
repeatLines: The Yeti lives north, up the stone path.

icehermit.name: Old Hermit
lines: Brrr... a visitor! I have not seen anyone up here since the princess.
She stopped by three days ago, looking for the Sunken Ruins across the frozen lake.
The ice is far too thin to cross on plain boots, though. The Yeti has the only pair of Frost Boots, and he has been in a foul mood.
repeatLines: Frost Boots, from the Yeti in the den to the north. He is not himself lately.
Take care, the ice has no mercy.

yeti_defeated: You beat the Yeti? Bless my beard! Now the lake is yours to cross.
Follow the thin ice east. The ruins gate is on the far shore.

ruinsgate.name: Ruined Gate
lines: An old gate of green stone, half sunk in the snow. Faint carvings show a princess and a crescent crest.
It does not budge yet...
repeatLines: The old gate will not budge yet. (To be continued)

ruinssign.name: Worn Stone
lines: The letters are worn, but you can read: "THREE RUNES WAKE THE INNER DOOR. THE GUARDIAN SLEEPS BEYOND."
repeatLines: Three runes wake the inner door.

runestone.name: Rune Stone
lines: A rune stone, cold and dark. You press your hand against it.
repeatLines: The rune is dark.

runestoneon.name: Rune Stone
lines: The rune glows a steady, watery green.
repeatLines: The rune glows a steady, watery green.

ruinsdoor.name: Inner Door
lines: A heavy stone door with three glowing slots. Three rune stones in the ruins must wake it.
repeatLines: Three runes wake this door.

ruinsdooropen.name: Inner Door
lines: The door stands open. Water drips somewhere beyond.
repeatLines: The way to the guardian is open.

princessnote.name: Princess's Note
lines: A note pinned under a smooth stone, in careful, royal handwriting:
"I split the Moon Crest in two so the dark one could never take it all. I left one half here with the guardian, under the old waves."
"The other half I carry to the desert market, where the caravans trade. If you are reading this, you are brave. Please hurry. - P."
repeatLines: "...to the desert market. Please hurry. - P."

desertsign.name: Sign
lines: THE GREAT DESERT. The bazaar lies far to the east. Beware the scorpions, and the pit to the south-east.
repeatLines: The bazaar is east. The Scorpion King's pit is south-east. Do not go unprepared.

bazaarsign.name: Sign
lines: THE DESERT BAZAAR. Armor, treats and gems. Follow the red rug.
repeatLines: The Desert Bazaar is just ahead.

bzsmith.name: Armorsmith
lines: Welcome, traveller, to the only armor stall for a hundred miles of sand.
Bring me gold and sunstones from the desert rocks, and I will craft you armor fit for a hero.
bzsmith.offer: Today I could craft {name}: {desc}. Good armor takes time. Come back after you have wandered off, and it will be ready.
bzsmith.ordered: Excellent! Go on, explore the dunes, and come back later.
bzsmith.working: Patience, friend! The {name} is still cooling. Leave the bazaar and come back, and it will be ready.
bzsmith.ready: Ah, there you are! Your {name} is finished. Wear it with pride!
bzsmith.done: I have no finer armor left to craft. You wear my best work.
bzsmith.farewell: The sun will wait for you.
repeatLines: Back again? Let us see what armor I can craft for you.

bzspice.name: Treat Seller
lines: Treats from every land! Carrots, herbs, crystals, berries, seaweed and cactus fruit. Something for every little friend.
repeatLines: Treats for your little friends?

bzgem.name: Gem Trader
lines: Gems! Sunstones! I pay the best prices in the whole bazaar.
repeatLines: Got any shiny things for me?

princess.name: Princess
lines: Oh! You made it. You must be the ninja who followed my notes.
I have been hiding in this tent. The dark whisper still hunts me.
I split the Moon Crest in two so it could never take both halves. The Scorpion King took the half I carried. He wears it in his pit, south-east of here.
Please, if you can... beat him and bring it back. The whisper has made him furious.
repeatLines: The Scorpion King wears the other half in his pit, south-east of here. Be careful.

scorpionking_defeated: You did it! You have both halves! Hold them together...
The Moon Crest is whole again. See how it glows? It points north, past the snowy peaks, to where the moon touches the mountain.
Take this Waystone Charm too. Touch the glowing waystones wherever you go, then open your bag and use the charm to travel back to any of them.
That is where the dark whisper sleeps. We will go together, when you are ready. (To be continued)

bzcust1.name: Camel Driver
lines: My camel will not walk past the armor stall. He is afraid of his own reflection.
repeatLines: Do not tell him.

bzcust2.name: Spice Merchant
lines: Cactus fruit is sweeter on the road than in the bazaar. Do not ask me why.
repeatLines: It is true.

bzcust3.name: Traveler
lines: I heard the princess is staying in the far stall, the one with the crown on the sign.
repeatLines: Say hello for me.

bzcust4.name: Little Trader
lines: A friend followed me all the way here. I named her Biscuit. She is a very good lizard.
repeatLines: Biscuit says hello.

waystone.name: Waystone
lines: A tall stone, cold and quiet.
repeatLines: A tall stone, cold and quiet.

waystoneon.name: Waystone
lines: The waystone glows softly. It remembers you.
repeatLines: The waystone glows softly. A Waystone Charm can bring you back here.
